anatomy.name: wrapped element
anatomy.description: The single focusable element the focus classes are applied to. FocusRing has no DOM node of its own - it clones its child.

children.description: The single focusable element to clone and merge focus classes onto.

borderWidth.description: Outline width - compact for small/dense controls.

disabled.description: Suppresses the outline entirely - use only when the wrapped control is itself disabled.

className.description: Composes with the merged class list.

offset.note: Not yet backed by a dedicated token - see Future Enhancements.

requirements: Only ever appears on :focus-visible, never on plain mouse :hover or :focus.
Does not make a non-focusable element focusable - the child must already be a real focusable element.
Does not add ARIA roles or labels - the wrapped element remains responsible for its own accessible name/role/value.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Sets the icon's container size, spacing box, and color; carries data-size/data-spacing/data-color for downstream CSS overrides.

anatomy.name: svg
anatomy.description: The glyph itself - fill="currentColor", focusable="false".

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Rendered only when decorative is false and title is provided; referenced via aria-labelledby.

spacing.description: Hit-box/container padding around the glyph, independent of its visual size.

title.description: Accessible name, used only when decorative is false.

decorative.description: When true, aria-hidden with no role. When false, role=img with title as the accessible name (via aria-labelledby).

className.description: Composes with the root's class list.

decorative.whenTrue: aria-hidden=true on the svg, no role
decorative.whenFalse: role=img on the svg, aria-labelledby pointing at an internal <title> built from the title prop

requirements: Default to decorative unless the icon is the sole carrier of meaning.
Provide title when decorative is false.
Do not add click handlers or make icons focusable - interactive behavior belongs to the parent (Button, Icon Button, Link).
Do not rely on an icon alone for critical meaning without an accessible name.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Renders the selected logo SVG asset directly; carries data-logo-type/data-logo-size.

title.description: Accessible name (and native tooltip via the title attribute); falls back to "LegacyHQ" when informative and no ariaLabel is given.

ariaLabel.description: Overrides the accessible name; takes precedence over title.

decorative.description: When true, aria-hidden with no role. When false (default), role=img with the accessible name.

className.description: Composes with the root's class list.

decorative.whenTrue: aria-hidden=true, no role - use when adjacent content already provides the same accessible name (e.g. a parent link with its own aria-label)
decorative.whenFalse: role=img with an accessible name from ariaLabel, then title, then "LegacyHQ"

requirements: Default is informative (decorative=false), unlike Icon - a logo is usually the accessible name for a link back to home.
Do not double up the accessible name - if the parent link already has aria-label, mark the Logo decorative.
Do not add roles beyond role=img.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Owns size, data attributes, focus ring classes, and accessibility attributes.

anatomy.name: surface
anatomy.description: Painted circular surface that owns radius, the full-size light or dark fallback SVG, and selected or interaction overlays.

anatomy.name: badgeContainer
anatomy.description: Dedicated placement container for presence or status.

anatomy.name: badgeIcon
anatomy.description: The actual presence dot or status icon inside the badge container, including the inverse border.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Single visual container for the badge value.

anatomy.name: text
anatomy.description: Short visible numeric value.

children.description: Visible badge content. Intended for short numeric values.

tone.description: Visual tone for badge emphasis or semantic meaning.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label when the visible value needs additional context.

ariaLabel.useWhen: Visible numeric value needs additional context.

requirements: Do not add button behavior.
Do not add keyboard interaction.
Use ariaLabel when the visible value is ambiguous.
Ensure color contrast meets requirements for all tones.

anatomy.name: leading
anatomy.description: leading icon slot or loading spinner

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: visible button label/content

anatomy.name: trailing
anatomy.description: trailing icon slot

color.disabledBorder: --color-border-disabled (appearance=default only - appearance=primary/subtle stay border-color: transparent when disabled, matching their own resting borderless look)

semantic.stopOnTrack: chart/sequence/brand/900 (contrasts with the light remaining track underneath)
semantic.stopOnProgress: chart/sequence/brand/300 (contrasts with the dark progress fill underneath)

componentForbidden: a fixed border/background pairing on the stop shape - it is a single flat fill that swaps token by segment

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Owns progress semantics and layout.

anatomy.name: dots
anatomy.description: Sequence of selected and unselected dots.

anatomy.name: selectedDot
anatomy.description: Represents the current step.

anatomy.name: unselectedDot
anatomy.description: Represents every other step.

label.description: Visible label. Omit only when aria-label/aria-labelledby is set.

required.description: Maps to native required. Appends a visible required indicator after the label.

className.description: Composes with the root label's class list.

inputClassName.description: Composes with the native input's class list.

anatomy.name: legend / group label (with optional required indicator)
options (from the options prop, or children)

label.description: Rendered as the fieldset legend; the group's accessible name.

errorMessage.description: Connected to the fieldset with aria-describedby when present.

name.description: Shared across every option generated from options. Auto-generated when omitted.

options.description: Generates one Radio per entry. Takes precedence over children when provided.

children.description: Custom layout of manually-wired Radio instances. Used only when options is omitted.

orientation.description: horizontal wraps via flex-wrap rather than overflowing.

required.description: Group-level required indicator, shown after the legend.

invalid.description: Sets aria-invalid on the fieldset and every generated option.

disabled.description: Disables the fieldset and every generated option.

accessibility.grouping: fieldset/legend via RadioGroup when a group label is provided
accessibility.ariaInvalid: set on the input (Radio) or the fieldset (RadioGroup) when invalid
accessibility.ariaDescribedBy: connects RadioGroup's description/errorMessage to the fieldset
doNotUse: role="radiogroup" in place of a native fieldset

color.selectedBorder: --color-border-brand-primary (tone=default only - tone=subtle stays border-color: transparent, matching its own resting borderless look)
--color-border-brand-primary (tone=default only - tone=subtle stays border-color: transparent, matching its own resting borderless look)

tokens.note: Horizontal padding is --measurement-6 (6px), a raw measurement rather than a semantic spacing token - Figma's own value doesn't land on the 4/8/12/16px spacing scale.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Landmark with an accessible name (default 'Breadcrumb').

anatomy.name: list
anatomy.description: Ordered list of breadcrumb items.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: One per entry in `items`, in order.

anatomy.name: separator
anatomy.description: A literal '/' character before every item except the first.

anatomy.name: link
anatomy.description: Rendered for every item that has an href.

anatomy.name: current
anatomy.description: Rendered for the item without an href - always the last item in practice.

items.description: Ordered list of trail entries, root first, current page last.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name for the nav landmark.

className.description: Optional custom class name for the root nav.

requirements: nav must always have an accessible name (aria-label, default 'Breadcrumb').
The current (last, href-less) item must carry aria-current="page".
Separators must be aria-hidden.
Do not add role=list/listitem manually - ol/li already carry the correct implicit roles.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Flex layout container that spaces and directs its children; owns no button styling.

anatomy.name: children
anatomy.description: Typically Button and/or IconButton elements, laid out with a consistent 4px gap.

children.description: The buttons (or other controls) to lay out.

requirements: Do not add roving tabindex or arrow-key navigation - children keep native Tab order.
Do not add a role without an accompanying accessible name.
Ensure each child button remains independently focusable.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Sized, colored, rounded container.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Single centered icon; inherits the root's color and fills the computed icon-size box.

children.description: The icon element to render, centered inside the tile.

appearance.description: Visual weight - default is a subtle tint, bold is a solid saturated fill with an inverse icon.

shape.description: Container shape - rounded-square or fully round.

size.description: Overall tile size; icon size is derived as 2/3 of the tile size.

decorative.description: When true, the tile is aria-hidden. When false, renders role=img with ariaLabel.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label used only when decorative is false.

requirements: Do not add button behavior.
Do not add keyboard interaction.
Use decorative=false with ariaLabel only when no adjacent text already conveys the same meaning.
Ensure color contrast meets requirements for all tone/appearance combinations.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Transparent layout wrapper - flex row, no color/border tokens of its own.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Holds the cloned children element - readOnly+value when not editing, draft+onChange when editing.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Trailing cancel/confirm IconButton pair; renders only once editing has started, when actionButtons is not false.

value.description: The last confirmed value. Owned by the parent - InlineEdit only tracks the in-progress draft.

children.description: A single controlled input-like element (e.g. a subtle TextField) InlineEdit clones for both the read-only display and the editable control.

onConfirm.description: Called with the draft value when the confirm button (or Enter) commits the edit.

onCancel.description: Called when the cancel button (or Escape) discards the draft and reverts to value.

actionButtons.description: Whether to render the confirm/cancel IconButton pair while editing. Enter/Escape still work when false.

confirmLabel.description: Accessible name (aria-label) for the confirm IconButton.

cancelLabel.description: Accessible name (aria-label) for the cancel IconButton.

className.description: Composes with the root's class list.

layout.rootGap: --spacing-sm (8px, between the field and the action row, stacked in a column)
layout.actionsGap: --spacing-xs (4px, between the cancel and confirm buttons themselves)

requirements: No role or accessible name of its own - a transparent wrapper around the cloned child.
confirmLabel/cancelLabel always set an aria-label on the internal IconButtons.
The cloned child stays in the tab order in both states (readOnly, not disabled) - focusing/clicking it starts editing.
Enter calls onConfirm (with the draft, and preventDefault) while editing; Escape calls onCancel while editing. Neither fires before editing starts.
Clicking/Tab-ing focus to anywhere outside the root while editing calls onConfirm with the draft (auto-save on blur); moving focus to the cancel/confirm buttons themselves does not.
No roving tabindex or custom focus management - native Tab order through the child, then cancel, then confirm.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Landmark with an accessible name (default 'Pagination').

anatomy.name: list
anatomy.description: Ordered list of pagination controls.

anatomy.name: previous
anatomy.description: Chevron-left control, disabled on the first page.

anatomy.name: page
anatomy.description: One per visible page number; isSelected + aria-current="page" on the current page.

anatomy.name: ellipsis
anatomy.description: Non-interactive '...' text wherever the range algorithm collapses a gap.

anatomy.name: next
anatomy.description: Chevron-right control, disabled on the last page.

onPageChange.description: Called with the target page when a page/previous/next control is activated.

siblingCount.description: Pages shown on either side of the current page.

boundaryCount.description: Pages always shown at the start and end of the range.

getPageLabel.description: aria-label generator for each page button.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name for the nav landmark.

className.description: Optional custom class name for the root nav.

requirements: nav must always have an accessible name (ariaLabel, default 'Pagination').
The current page control must carry aria-current="page".
Previous/next must have accessible names and must be disabled at the first/last page.
The ellipsis must be aria-hidden and non-interactive.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Sized, colored, rounded placeholder shape that pulses on an infinite loop.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Rendered only when the `label` prop is set; announces the loading state to assistive technology.

appearance.description: Visual weight of the placeholder fill.

shape.description: Corner treatment - circle is fully round, for avatar-shaped placeholders.

label.description: Accessible loading announcement. When set, renders role=status/aria-live=polite instead of aria-hidden.

labelled.whenSet: role=status, aria-live=polite, visually-hidden announcement of the label text

requirements: Do not add interactive behavior.
Do not add keyboard interaction.
Set label only when no adjacent context already conveys that the region is loading.
Disable the pulse animation under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

sizingDetail.override: Forwarded style/className on the root div - no dedicated width/height props.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Bordered frame holding the optional before/action slots and the input; reacts to :hover and :focus-within.

anatomy.name: iconBefore
anatomy.description: Optional leading icon or short text prefix. Always decorative - never interactive.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: The real native text input; carries all forwarded native attributes.

anatomy.name: iconAfter
anatomy.description: Optional trailing icon or interactive action (e.g. an IconButton clear button). Never forced aria-hidden.

size.description: Frame height, padding, gap, and typography.

appearance.description: default is bordered at rest, rounded on all four corners; subtle has no visible border/background until hover, focus, or invalid, and always has square bottom corners.

invalid.description: Sets aria-invalid and the error border (thicker, regardless of focus).

iconBefore.description: Optional leading icon or short text prefix. Always decorative (aria-hidden).

iconAfter.description: Optional trailing icon or interactive control (typically an IconButton clear action, or a Button). Never forced aria-hidden.

className.description: Composes with the root frame's class list.

inputClassName.description: Composes with the native input's class list.

requirements: Render a real native <input> - never fake one.
Set aria-invalid on the input when invalid is true.
iconBefore is aria-hidden - decorative only, never interactive.
iconAfter is never forced aria-hidden - it may hold a real interactive control (e.g. an IconButton clear action) which must keep its own accessible name and stay keyboard-reachable.
Text Field does not manage labelling - pair with a native label[htmlFor] or aria-label/aria-labelledby.
